title: Impostor detection (the Netflix check)
headline: Lookalike domain + outlier amount caught: IMPOSTOR (R_IMPOSTOR_LOOKALIKE)

steps.label: Scenario setup
steps.detail: An email arrives: “URGENT — your Netflix account will be suspended, settle $49.99 now” from billing@netflix-payments.com
